exposure: trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC)
indications of the previous cesarean section
outcome: Success of trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC)
finding: A prenatal forecasting scale for TOLAC using six indicators (cervical score, fetal weight, body mass index, age, vaginal delivery history, and previous obstructive dystocia) was found to be a good predictor of successful VBAC.
mod_finding: A predelivery scoring system, incorporating factors like cervical score, fetal weight, and history of vaginal delivery, was found to be helpful in predicting successful vaginal birth after cesarean section.
